text: Lesson 10 automated BrennanERP's backups -- but every one of them still lands in the same building as the server. This lesson sends a real copy off-site, to Azure.
A geo-replicated storage account, brennansqlbackups, with a dedicated container, offsite-backups, authenticated by a SAS token scoped to just that container -- not the whole account.
Backup-to-URL lets SQL Server write directly to that container over HTTPS. The credential's name matches the container URL exactly, and the token carries its own expiration date.
Rather than build a second pipeline, Backup-DbaDatabase's own Azure parameters fold straight into the existing lesson-10 job -- one schedule now writes to two places, local and off-site.
Brennan's backups now survive more than a server failure -- they survive the building. The buildout continues from here.
